item.title: Palmer Luckey Warns AI‑Powered Hacks Outpace Defenses
item.description: Palmer Luckey warned at the NYT Deal Book Summit that AI‑powered cyberattacks are outpacing defenses, tying recent outages to state‑backed exploits.
